sentence: This project builds resources and programming to support cancer research scholars from underrepresented groups.
This project studies how cells use an RNA quality control pathway to fight infection by RNA viruses.
This project builds a tool that follows gene expression over time and place inside a tumor to see how immune cells and cancer cells interact.
This project studies lipid-driven cell death in cancer cells that resist drugs, using a method that maps lipids inside cells.
This project studies a protein that binds and cuts RNAs in cells and is linked to many epithelial cancer types.
This project tries to find out whether adult stem cells pass mitochondria to adjacent cells to keep their metabolism working in aged tissues.
This project studies how proteins called neuroligins in the brain cells that make oligodendrocytes affect synaptic connectivity and myelination.
This project uses naturally aged three-dimensional engineered muscle tissue to study how muscle loss with aging, called sarcopenia, happens.
This project uses molecular, clinical and public health data to guide efforts that stop HIV from spreading in a small state.
This project studies how a recently identified gene mutation leads to intellectual disability, epilepsy and autism.
This project uses machine learning to help tailor treatment that prevents depression in pregnant women before it starts.
This project studies an RNA found in mitochondria to learn how it acts in heart muscle cells during heart failure.
This project uses artificial intelligence to predict clinical outcomes of psychosis from electronic health records and genetic information.
This project builds computer methods that make photoacoustic tomography give quantitative images of changing processes in small animal models.
This project provides shared resources for human studies of how environmental exposures, including air pollutants, affect the lungs.
This project studies the viral mutations that make human cytomegalovirus resistant to antiviral drugs.
This project uses a natural language processing algorithm to find patients with covert cerebrovascular disease and plans a clinical trial on preventing stroke and dementia.
This project manages and analyzes genomics, epigenomics and proteome data to help explain how breast cancer spreads, stays dormant and awakens.
This project supports suicide prevention research by applying statistical and machine learning methods to complex real-world and clinical trial data.
This project supports teams that develop biomedical imaging technologies by running the day-to-day operations of an imaging center.
